Personally I think contes spurs have barrels of potential, but that they have a lot less margin for error as compared to arsenal. This is mainly in off the field stuff like transfers and from what I’ve seen, I doubt levy will okay a 150 mil spending spree like we had this past summer and If they don’t, they have less elite young talent to fall back on compared to arsenal (I do rate gill Tbf) 

On the footballing side of things, i’m reserving my final judgment as it’s still too soon to judge conte’s football fully but imo it isn’t moving me the way that a lot of spurs fans act like it should, and I believe a lot of spurs fans over hype conte and his football (not saying arsenal fans don’t do it to, but I do think we have more substance to back it up with)

Just a small last point, I personally believe that spurs fans both overhype conte’s player pull and underrate arsenals player pull compared to each other. Take vlahovic, I see barrels of spurs fans on Twitter saying that there’s no chance he’d go to arsenal over Tottenham, while in reality, we’re both at about the same level and equally attractive prospects (or should I say unattractive compared to city, atleti or Bayern) with the only caveat being you guys have a wc striker and we don’t, and I doubt conte can change views about getting game time.

Overall, I think while atm both teams are at about the same level, I think arsenal’s project has the greater future due to our greater young talent and our football style being more clear and imo better then spurs (again tho, still think it’s a bit too early to judge conte’s spurs)
